rationale: Analytically plausible and aligned with MISEV guidance; proceed to pilot validation. Testing should prioritize (1) a well‑characterized, non‑crossreactive spike‑in and buffer/capture compatibility panels, (2) orthogonal checks to exclude detergent‑resistant non‑vesicular co‑isolates, and (3) reproducibility across ≥3 independent conditioned‑medium lots and pilot GMP runs to assess yield/throughput before operational adoption.
